findings.evidence:
`pkg/statistics/handle/usage/collector/collector.go:63`-`71`: `SpawnSession()` returns `&sessionCollector[T]{ timeout: g.timeout, dataCh: g.dataCh, highPriorityDataCh: g.highPriorityDataCh, lastUpdate: time.Now() }` but never sets `closeCh`.
`pkg/statistics/handle/usage/collector/collector.go:163`-`171`: `SendDeltaSync` does `select { case s.highPriorityDataCh <- data: ...; case <-s.closeCh: return false }`; with `closeCh` left as nil, the close case is permanently disabled.
`pkg/statistics/handle/usage/indexusage/collector.go:226`-`233`: `SessionIndexUsageCollector.Flush()` calls `s.collector.SendDeltaSync(...)`.
`pkg/session/session.go:2577`-`2579`: session `Close()` calls `s.idxUsageCollector.Flush()`.
`pkg/statistics/handle/handle.go:203`-`208`: `Handle.Close()` calls `h.StatsUsage.Close()` (closing the global collector) independently of per-session lifecycles.
findings.fix:
In `pkg/statistics/handle/usage/collector/collector.go`, wire the global close channel into spawned sessions: add `closeCh: g.closeCh` in `(*globalCollector[T]).SpawnSession()`.
Optionally harden shutdown semantics by closing/draining data channels on `Close()` (or making `SendDeltaSync` return immediately when closed) and by checking `SendDeltaSync` return value in callers that currently ignore it (e.g. `indexusage.SessionIndexUsageCollector.Flush`).
findings.impact: If any session calls `Flush()` after the global collector worker has exited (e.g., shutdown ordering or late session teardown), `SendDeltaSync` can block indefinitely once the buffered `highPriorityDataCh` fills (default size 10). This can hang session teardown paths and potentially stall shutdown/cleanup routines.
findings.later_fix_evidence: Checked `upstream/master` at `b75374faa619e24e380292fdbdf0f6fe5bf11943`: `pkg/statistics/handle/usage/collector/collector.go` still has `SpawnSession()` not setting `closeCh`, while `SendDeltaSync` still selects on `<-s.closeCh`.
findings.what: `collector.globalCollector.SpawnSession()` fails to propagate the global `closeCh` to `sessionCollector`, so `SendDeltaSync()` cannot observe closure and may block forever once buffers fill after the worker stops (notably via `SessionIndexUsageCollector.Flush()` on session close).

subject: statistics/handle/usage: modify the `SessionIndexUsageCollector` to implement new index usage design (#50050)
summary: This change replaces the old per-session linked-list `SessionIndexUsageCollector` with a new `indexusage.Collector` + background merge worker, updates session/executor wiring to report usage stats (`ReportUsageStats`) and flush per-session deltas on session close, and removes the old KV dump/sync lease path. One high-severity concurrency/shutdown risk remains in the underlying generic collector used by the new design.
